title: Traffic-split Eval Gatekeeper for A/B Canaries
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
A lightweight, policy-driven 'Gatekeeper' service that evaluates A/B and traffic-split canaries using pre-defined eval suites and automated rollback rules. Goals: 1) Detect quality regressions within the first N% of traffic using statistical tests; 2) Support simultaneous multi-variant experiments (A/B/n) and asymmetric thresholds; 3) Tie decisions to config/model tag changes and surface exact counterfactual metrics; 4) Expose actionable signals to Console and trigger automated rollbacks when safety criteria breach.

Design highlights:
- Traffic-aware windowing: compute metrics on sliding windows tied to absolute request counts and time (min 1k requests or 5 minutes).
- Statistical significance: two-sided bootstrap + Bayesian credible intervals for small-sample experiments; default alpha=0.05 but configurable per-route.
- Metric types: scalar (e.g., automated eval pass rate), distributional (e.g., token-level perplexity), and user-sentinel (custom heuristics). Each metric has an alignment direction (higher/better or lower/better).
- Decision policy: each variant evaluated across the metric set; failure if any critical metric drops by more than relative delta threshold (default 5%) with statistical confidence >95% or if absolute quality floor violated.
- Rollback orchestration: supports immediate rollback, gradual traffic reduction, and staged wait-for-improvement policies. Actions are executed via the rollout controller API with audit logs and can be manual-approve gated.
- Observability: push detailed diagnostics (per-interval metrics, CI/p-value, sample sizes) to Console, attach counterfactual traces to the rollout event, and create temporary dashboards for the experiment.

Acceptance criteria:
- Gatekeeper evaluates deployed variants and emits a pass/fail signal within configured window for 90% of canary rollouts in staging.
- Automated rollback triggers correctly for simulated regressions in the regression harness (linked below).
- Console shows per-variant eval summary, windowed metric series, and rollback provenance link.
- End-to-end test: deploy model X->Y with intentional metric drop; Gatekeeper triggers rollback and rollout controller returns to previous stable variant and marks the event in audit logs.
